conversation:
maria: Quick heads-up — we plan to flip LOG_EXPOSURE_MODE=restricted for hosted + dedicated at 16:00 PT today. This will strip request bodies for sampled logs and set sampling to 1% by default. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/log-cutover

devin: What exactly is 'restricted'? does it redact entire request or just PII fields? @maria

maria: Restricted = drop request.body, keep metadata (route, status, latency, model). We will still keep hashed ids for request linkage. PII heuristics remain enabled for traces.

sahil: Console UX ask — can we surface when a specific invocation was redacted? e.g., show "redacted by policy" with link to trace id so SREs can request breakglass? otherwise support will be 👍 tough.

elaine: Need to update dashboards before flip: traffic-by-route, error-rate, median-latency per model. Also create a 'redaction-rate' metric so we can monitor how many requests were stripped (by route + tier).

jim: Rollout plan? full flip or canary? I'd prefer canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 1h with automatic rollback on error>3% or latency regressed >30ms.

maria: Canary plan agreed. Ops runbook has canary stages. Breakglass path: oncall can set LOG_EXPOSURE_MODE=inspect for a customer to temporarily see bodies (requires audit log entry). We must tighten access to that toggle.

devin: Audit log retention question — if bodies are dropped at ingress, are they kept anywhere else (e.g., debug snapshots)? We must ensure copies don't persist in S3 or event bus.

maria: Confirmed: replicas and archival pipelines will respect the new flag; no snapshots will include body after cutover. We still have a 24h short-term inspect bucket that is manually gated.

ops-bot: [deploy scheduled] policy-cutover-job queued for 2026-04-12T16:00:00-07:00 by maria. ID: job-2134

telemetry-bot: Canary metrics (5m window) will be posted to #eng-platform-metrics. Alerts: redaction-rate > 10% on any route, 5xx increase >0.5%.

sahil: UI item for console: show a small badge on traces "redacted" with a hover explaining reason and link to request an audited view (requires oncall approval). Product to approve wording?

elaine: I'll create the dashboard tiles and add the redaction-rate to the shared team view. tagging @sahil for UX.

jim: +1 to staged rollout. Also we should add a telemetry tag to sampled requests indicating "redaction_mode=restricted" so offline evals know the sample is truncated.

maria: Good call. Add header X-Redwood-Redaction: restricted on sampled traces. Update runbook and deployment checklist.

devin: If anything goes sideways, who's primary oncall? @jim on infra, @maria on platform? Need clear ownership in runbook.

maria: Primary oncall: jim. Secondary: maria. Ops docs updated.

sahil: One more UX note — when users search logs, suppressed bodies should show a one-click request audit flow (request reason, TTL, approver). Keep it minimal.

maria: Thanks team. I'll wait for final thumbs-up and will schedule the canary. :thumbsup:

devin: :+1:

jim: :rocket:

elaine: I'll drop dashboard links once created.

maria: Final note: post-cutover retrospective in #eng-platform next week, include telemetry export so we can validate sampling impact on alerting.
